funding.label: Council tax
funding.desc: What residents pay through the council's part of the bill

funding.label: Revenue Support Grant
funding.desc: The council's main general grant from government. From 2026/27 it includes funding that used to come through business rates and separate grants

funding.label: Business rates kept locally
funding.official_term: Retained income from Rate Retention Scheme
funding.desc: The share of local business rates the council keeps

funding.label: Schools grants (ring-fenced)
funding.official_term: Dedicated Schools Grant and other education grants
funding.desc: Passed to schools; cannot be spent on anything else

funding.label: Public health grant (ring-fenced)
funding.desc: Can only be spent on public health

funding.label: Other government grants
funding.official_term: Other specific and special grants within AEF
funding.desc: Grants for adult care, children and families, homelessness and others, including the income protection floor

funding.label: Drawn from council reserves
funding.official_term: Appropriations from earmarked and unallocated reserves
funding.desc: One-off: once spent, the gap returns the year after
